note: One row per numbered step of the 14-pass manual plan. 'expect' is copied verbatim from the plan and is the acceptance criterion; 'mode': 'manual' marks a step that cannot be graded on an emulator (hardware, real biometric, vendor skin). 'run' is the host orchestration: instrumented phase, then host action, then the next phase.

passes.title: Guest home (6 min) — the heart of it

steps.expect: "Guest Mode" + "Only approved apps", lock icon
Pinned if you accepted the system dialog, Soft lock if not
A warning banner appears: "Home and Recents are not blocked"
Only your 3 chosen apps, with real icons and names
It opens normally, full screen
With pinning on: both are blocked. Without: you can leave — and the banner already told you so
Blocked/black — FLAG_SECURE is on
Guest home is excluded from Recents
Ongoing "Guest Mode is on · ends in 24:31" (if permission granted)

steps.action: With a timer set, watch the countdown
steps.expect: Updates every second, matches the notification
Lock screen: "Owner only", PIN dots, keypad
Returns to guest home — a guest cannot escape by cancelling
Red error, dots clear
Cool-down starts at 30 s; keypad disabled; a countdown or message shows

steps.action: 🔨 Force-stop and relaunch during the cool-down
steps.expect: Still locked — the cool-down survives the app being killed

steps.action: Wait it out, then 5 more wrong
steps.expect: Cool-down doubles to 60 s (cap 15 min)
BiometricPrompt; a wrong finger doesn't unlock; Use PIN falls back to the keypad
steps.why: needs an enrolled fingerprint and a physical finger; the emulator has no biometric hardware enrolled

Applies instantly, survives a restart, and the guest home follows too
4 rows with live status + a "Never requested" list that includes Internet

steps.expect: Row shows "Not granted" with a button to fix it

steps.action: 🔨 Start a session with notifications revoked
steps.expect: Session still starts; the ongoing notification is simply absent

steps.action: Pull the shade → edit tiles → add Guest Mode
steps.expect: Tile appears

steps.expect: "Tap to start a guest session"

steps.expect: Opens the app on the confirm screen — it does not silently start a session

steps.expect: Jumps straight back into the running guest home; tile is active
